# Erique Berdos

Canonical portfolio: https://qir05.github.io/PortfolioEbberdos/

Erique Berdos, also known professionally as Eriq Berdos, is a web developer, systems architect, and automation engineer based in Davao City, Philippines.

Core capabilities:
- Next.js and React web development
- Backend systems, REST APIs, and webhooks
- CRM architecture and GoHighLevel automation
- Google Tag Manager and GA4 analytics
- Technical SEO, AEO, and GEO
- GitHub, Vercel, deployment, QA, and production verification
- Internal business systems and operational workflow automation

Selected project evidence:
- PHASES Clinic
- Sundance House
- Ocean Villas at Turtle Bay
- LINKS HRIS
- SiLak Davao
- Vaze Demo Website Lab

Public profiles:
